programme.desc: Kai-lan gets a phone call from her favorite great aunt , Gu-nai-nai, in China, inviting us to come to China and meet a baby panda! Ye-Ye, Kai-lan, and her friends take an airplane to China to meet the baby.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends are hiking through the woods to the big Ladybug Festival! Tolee gets frustrated when the others don't listen to what he has to say. Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan, Rintoo and Stompy are making a special dinosaur-shaped balloon for Lulu's hot air balloon festival!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Everyone's going over to Tolee's boat house to play, and Kai-lan invites us, too! All the friends have a great time... until Rintoo accidentally rips Tolee's new panda painting.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Hoho is thrilled because he's finally old enough to stay awake for the Chinese Moon Festival. He gets disappointed when he can't see the moon in the cloudy sky and Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends are putting on a play based on the Chinese folktale about the Monkey King. When Rintoo gets the part that Hoho wanted, Hoho quits the play and it's up to the viewer to help Kai-lan figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Today, Kai-lan needs our help to plan a very special party for Ye-Ye to thank him for all he does for us. But when everything she plans goes wrong, Kai-lan gets very frustrated and starts to cry - much to the surprise of her friends!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends are riding a TRAIN all the way to Hula Duck Island! Everyone loves riding the train through the backyard, but when it gets to Stompy's house, there are no seats left for their elephant friend on the train.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends go to see the Chinese Rabbit Acrobats and are invited to be in the show! Rintoo is sure he'll be able to flip without practicing - no problem! Kai-lan needs your help to convince Rintoo to practice.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Today, Ye-Ye is taking Kai-lan and our friends to a super special, magical water park! Everyone's having a blast – until Rintoo starts splashing, cannonballing, and playing much too rough.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan sees the ants dancing in Ant City, and is inspired to help them put on a big dance show for everyone to see! But when they start to get ready, a bossy ant named BuBu makes all the choices about the dance routine.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Today, we're all invited over to Lulu's magical house in the clouds! Kai-lan is thrilled that Mr. Dragon is flying us there.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan invites us to come sail a beautiful dinosaur boat with her friends – and play hide and seek with some dolphins! But when Rintoo won't give Tolee a turn steering the boat, things come to a standstill.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan invites us to a dance party at the Hula Ducks' island beach house! But when the party games lead to Tolee having to sit out each time, he starts to cry.

programme.title: South Park: La Mort d'Eric Cartman
programme.desc: Les enfants se mettent d'accord pour ignorer Cartman, et ce dernier croit qu'il est mort. Butters, qui n'est pas au courant de la supercherie, devient le médium de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Le jour des érections
programme.desc: Jimmy a des problèmes d'érections impromptues. Étant donné qu'il doit participer au concours de talents, il cherche de l'aide pour résoudre ce problème.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Butters maquille sa mort pour que les garçons puissent récupérer un appareil à faire des prédictions.

programme.title: South Park: Suivez cet œuf
programme.desc: Madame Garrison a encore des sentiments pour Monsieur Esclave, mais en allant le voir elle s'aperçoit qu'il est avec Al Super Gay et qu'ils comptent se marier.

programme.title: South Park: Les Rouquins
programme.desc: Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park: Piégé dans le placard
programme.desc: Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: South Park: Sauvez Wilzy-X
programme.desc: Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park: Le Retour de Chef
programme.desc: Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Danger Snobfog
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park: Un million de petites fibres
programme.desc: Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park: Homoursporc
programme.desc: Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir
programme.desc: Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.
programme.sub-title: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir

programme.title: South Park: La Maitresse de Ike
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Cartman d'être le surveillant des couloirs, il profite de l'autorité qui lui est confié pour faire régner l'ordre sévèrement. Pendant ce temps, Ike tombe amoureux de sa maîtresse et ils ont une relation ensemble.

programme.title: South Park: L'Enfer sur Terre
programme.desc: Satan organise une énorme fête pour petite gamine pourrie gâtée pendant que les enfants de South Park tentent d'invoquer le rappeur Biggie Small en prononçant trois fois son nom devant un miroir.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (1/2)
programme.desc: Éric ne supporte plus d'attendre la sortie de la Nintendo Wii et ne veut pas endurer trois semaines de patience supplémentaire. Il décide alors de se congeler pour se réveiller le jour de la sortie de la Wii.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (2/2)
programme.desc: Toujours 500 ans dans le futur, Cartman est mêlé à la guerre mais ils est plus préoccupé à trouver un moyen de jouer à la Wii. Cela étant impossible dans le futur, il cherche une façon de retourner à son époque.

programme.title: South Park: La Coupe Stanley
programme.desc: Stan entraîne l'équipe poussins de hockey et essaie d'en faire des gagnants.

programme.title: South Park: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy Marsh dit le mot « nègre » à la télévision nationale et devient la risée du pays ; Cartman se moque d'un nain et se bat contre lui.
programme.sub-title: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson

programme.title: South Park: La Photo
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire croire que Butters est gay, mais lorsque le père de ce dernier s'en aperçoit, il envoie Butters dans un camp de rééducation.

programme.title: South Park: Les Poux
programme.desc: Une infection de poux atteint l'école primaire de South Park. Alors que Madame Garrison refuse de donner des noms, Cartman trouve un moyen de savoir qui a des poux et ainsi de se moquer des enfants atteints.

programme.title: South Park: Chattomique
programme.desc: Un nouvel élève arrive a South Park : un jeune arabe. Cartman pense alors qu'un attentat se prépare. Grâce à Kyle, branché sur Internet, ils remontent la piste d'un attentat imminent sur Hillary Clinton en visite à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Le Fantastique Mystère de Pâques
programme.desc: Stan se demande pourquoi on doit peindre des œufs le jour de Pâques. Il ne s'attendait pas à découvrir un secret aussi énorme.

programme.title: South Park: G-Win!
programme.desc: Madame Garrison se fait plaquer pour la dernière fois. Elle compte bien passer toute sa colère sur sa classe de CM1.

programme.title: South Park: La Nuit des clochards-vivants
programme.desc: La ville doit faire face à une recrudescence des SDF. Les enfants vont essayer de régler ce problème épineux.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman prétend avoir le syndrome Gilles de la Tourette pour pouvoir dire des choses affreuses en direct à la télévision.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Caca
programme.desc: Randy est constipé. Il prend alors des laxatifs pour aller déféquer. Après quelques instants de terribles douleurs sur le trône, Randy s'apprête à tirer la chasse mais il remarque que son caca est démesurément grand.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 1
programme.desc: Eric assure avoir aperçu un leprechaun dans la forêt, mais Kyle ne le croit pas. Ils font un pari ensemble : si Cartman prouve l'existence du leprechaun, Kyle devra lui sucer les boules sinon il devra donner 10$ à Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 2
programme.desc: Les pires créatures ont été libérées par les terroristes et dévastent Imaginationland, où Butters est toujours piégé. Le gouvernement réquisitionne Stan et Kyle afin de trouver un moyen d'entrer à Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 3
programme.desc: Suite à l'accident du portail, Stan est entré dans Imaginationland où Butters est considéré par les créatures imaginaires comme un élu capable de sauver Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Zéro
programme.desc: Stan et Kyle sont accros au jeu Guitar Hero. Mais Stan est meilleur que Kyle, et leur amitié semble s'en dégrader.

programme.title: South Park: La Liste
programme.desc: Les filles ont une liste des garçons les plus beaux de la classe. Clyde est premier, mais à sa grande déception Kyle est dernier.

programme.title: South Park: Amygdales
programme.desc: Cartman se retrouve à devoir lutter pour sa vie lorsqu'une banale opération des amygdales tourne mal.

programme.title: South Park: Le Nouveau Look de Britney
programme.desc: Alors que les garçons aident Britney Spears à atteindre le pôle Nord, ils découvrent le secret qui se cache derrière sa popularité.

programme.title: South Park: Planète Gros Nibards
programme.desc: Dans cet hommage de South Park au film de 1981 « Métal Hurlant », les garçons découvrent que ce qui défonce réellement, c'est le pipi de chat.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?
programme.sub-title: THE FORCE THAT COULD DESTROY THE WORLD! THE POWER OF THE TREMOR-TREMOR FRUIT!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There's only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!
programme.sub-title: AN ALL-CONSUMING INFERNO!! ADMIRAL AKAINU'S POWER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm's reach of his friend when he's intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!
programme.sub-title: A DESCENDANT OF THE BEAST! LITTLE OARS JR. FULL SPEED AHEAD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the wake of Little Oars Junior's tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace's execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!
programme.sub-title: JUSTICE FOR THE WINNERS! SENGOKU'S STRATEGY IN ACTION!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man's refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!
programme.sub-title: STRAW HAT TEAM ARRIVES! TENSION GROWS AT THE BATTLEFIELD

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!
programme.sub-title: EVEN IF IT MEANS DEATH! LUFFY VS. THE NAVY; THE BATTLE STARTS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy's own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!
programme.sub-title: HARD BATTLES, ONE AFTER ANOTHER! DEVIL FRUIT EATERS VS. DEVIL FRUIT EATERS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san's Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!
programme.sub-title: KUMA'S TRANSFORMATION! IVA'S BLOW OF ANGER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy's onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren't ready to give up the fight!
programme.sub-title: THE GREAT SWORDSMAN MIHAWK! LUFFY COMES UNDER THE ATTACK OF THE BLACK SWORD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!
programme.sub-title: THE EXTERMINATION STRATEGY IN ACTION! THE POWER OF THE PACIFISTAS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard is betrayed – and brutally stabbed – by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy's defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!
programme.sub-title: THE ENCIRCLING WALLS ACTIVATED! THE WHITEBEARD PIRATES BACKED INTO A CORNER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!
programme.sub-title: EXECUTION ORDER ISSUED! BREAK THROUGH THE ENCIRCLING WALLS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile's unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!
programme.sub-title: MOVING INTO THE FINAL PHASE! WHITEBEARD'S TRUMP CARD FOR RECOVERY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY AT THE END OF HIS TETHER! AN ALL-OUT BATTLE AT THE ORIS PLAZA!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a troubled youth seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!
programme.sub-title: THE POWER THAT WILL SHORTEN ONE'S LIFE! ENERGY HORMONE, REDUX!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner's swords hovering above Ace's head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!
programme.sub-title: TO LIVE UP TO A PROMISE! LUFFY AND COBY COLLIDE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises to derail the rescue mission at the last second!
programme.sub-title: THE SCAFFOLD AT LAST! THE WAY TO ACE HAS OPENED!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight – his own grandfather – in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won't be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide backup!
programme.sub-title: EACH ON DIFFERENT PATHS! LUFFY VS. GARP!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Despite Whitebeard's order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!
programme.sub-title: THE POWER THAT CAN BURN EVEN FIRE! AKAINU'S RUTHLESS PURSUIT!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.
programme.sub-title: LOOKING FOR THE ANSWER! FIRE FIST ACE DIES ON THE BATTLEFIELD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace's tragic death. Luffy – paralyzed by grief – must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!
programme.sub-title: THE NAVY HEADQUARTERS FALLS! WHITEBEARD'S UNSPEAKABLE WRATH!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard's children watch in horror as the old man faces off against the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never runs away from a fight!
programme.sub-title: ENDING THE MATTER! WHITEBEARD VS. THE BLACKBEARD PIRATES!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The world reacts to Whitebeard's death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy. Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!
programme.sub-title: THE SHOW BEGINS! BLACKBEARD'S PLOT IS REVEALED!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy's desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu's fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!
programme.sub-title: THE INSATIABLE AKAINU! LAVA FISTS PUMMEL LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route. Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-haired marine changes the world with a scream!
programme.sub-title: THE DESPERATE SCREAM! COURAGEOUS MOMENTS THAT WILL CHANGE THE FUTURE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!
programme.sub-title: HERE COMES SHANKS! THE WAR OF THE BEST IS FINALLY OVER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard's death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy's friends fear that Ace's death may be more than the rubber-man can handle – if he ever wakes up!
programme.sub-title: MIGHTY LEADERS FACE EACH OTHER DOWN! HERALDING THE 'NEW ERA'!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard. Luffy's nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!
programme.sub-title: LANDING AT THE MAIDEN ISLAND! THE HARSH REALITY FALLS UPON LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One Piece X Toriko Crossover

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY AND ACE! THE STORY OF HOW THE BROTHERS MET!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!
programme.sub-title: HERE COMES SABO! THE BOY AT THE GRAY TERMINAL!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight – even when he's outnumbered!
programme.sub-title: I WON'T RUN! ACE'S DESPERATE RESCUE OPERATION!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots, and Diego race to the rescue!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What makes a good wife? Is it cooking, cleaning, raising the kids and having great sex? Dr. Phil says too few couples understand what it means to be a "Mrs." He delves into the role of the wife in 2005.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: John says his ex-wife, Laurie, abandoned their children. John admits his boys disrespect his authority, with one son punching him in the face. As Laurie denies deserting her children, we hear from the three boys: is it clueless parenting or unruly kids?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A bride-to-be takes on her future mother-in-law in an ugly feud that has torn a family apart. Can Dr. Phil cut through the drama and broker some peace for this family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say the green-eyed monster has affected their marriage. Paula claims loyalty and Mike questions her fidelity. Mike placed listening devices in the home, set up surveillance cameras to follow her, and subjected Paula to polygraph tests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's interview with death row inmate Rodney Reed continues. Reed's attorney, Bryce Benjet tells what he thinks happened to Stacey. Retired NYPD detective Kevin Gannon & criminologist Dr. Lee Gilbertson say they know who killed Stacey & how.
programme.sub-title: What Happened To Stacey? What The Evidence Shows Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristi says daughter Haley has always been a compulsive liar. She says lies Haley has told are that she was a contestant on American Idol, rapper Eminem is her father and she’s diagnosed paranoid schizophrenic. Now she says she's 9 months pregnant. Part 1
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Is Delusional And Lying About Being 9 Months Pregnant Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're in difficult economic times & looking for ways to save money, start taking notes! Dr. Phil's guests offer tips to help save on clothes, utilities & vacations. Learn how to cut your grocery bill in half & how to entertain family inexpensively.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to Tatiana about a horrific tale of survival: From ages 6-25, her dad forced her to do drugs to sexually abuse her daily; he impregnated her 4 times & she had 3 of his children; he tortured her & beat her with a bat; he stabbed her twice.
programme.sub-title: Held Captive, Drugged, And Abused By My Own Father

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they endure abuse from their grown children. Debbie says daughter, Amy, 31, is verbally & physically abusive. Amy admits she can be cruel to her mom, but Debbie makes her feel like a failure. As tempers flare see who storms off!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues conversation with Shemida and her sister, Dana, who says Shemida’s 70-plus diagnoses are tearing the family apart. Dr. Phil unites this family in an effort to find answers. Is Shemida really sick, or is she addicted to attention? Part 2
programme.sub-title: Hypochondriac, High Drama, Or Really Sick: Saving Shemida Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a drug-abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he break down and take it?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.
programme.sub-title: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues discussion with exes Michael and Susan, as well as Susan’s new husband, Cory, about the care of 11-year-old Bodhi, who Susan insists is experiencing schizophrenia, just like Michael and Susan’s 16-year-old daughter, Janni. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Second Schizophrenic Child Or A Misdiagnosing Mom: Can Bodhi Be Helped Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They threaten, scream, intimidate and even bite. They are not tantrum-throwing tots ... they are bullying dads!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Teens are obsessed with love more than ever. Parents are concerned over measures their daughters take to keep a boyfriend. A poll asked teens about extreme behavior, some saying they had sex when the didn't want to. Parents, don't miss these safety steps.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How did 21-year-old Jenna go from being a straight-A UC Berkeley student and former beauty queen to abusing heroin and meth and used as sexual currency in a drug house? Her mom is desperate to save her only child and turns to Dr. Phil for intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked about guests on Dr. Phil returns--Brandon! Plus, a desperate family turns to Dr. Phil to save their daughter who is addicted to OxyContin and heroin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you and your beloved say "I do," it's "for better or worse." But what happens when all you feel is the "worse" part and wind up trapped in a bad marriage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil digs into a heartbreaking story of a father's search for his missing daughter, then the loss of his grandchildren taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. Don't miss this chilling tale that spans three generations.
programme.sub-title: What The Children Remember: Was Mommy Murdered

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is the number one reason why couples say they get divorced. The country's current financial crisis has resulted in more couples getting buried in a landslide of debt which takes its toll on a marriage. Is your marriage on the rocks because of debt?

programme.desc: Logan, 30, desperately needs help. Mom Tracy says he has gone from a productive computer science engineer to a shell of a human being: no motivation, rarely eats, & can barely function to take care of his basic hygiene needs. Can Logan get back on track?
